checks.topic: Final transaction binds CID to exact descriptor root
checks.reason: The CID current principal, owner, workspace, scope/ACL, and write revocation/fence are resolved within accounts._transaction. Private _dispatch/_find compare descriptor mapping.id to that resolved mapping.id before receipt publication. The transaction already holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE; no second public service transaction or cross-target reverse resolution is introduced.

The exact fixed binding resolves conversation_id and validates the nine-field frozen view before leaving accounts._transaction. Any SELECT/model construction failure rolls back task event, cursor and receipt; commit occurs only after projection succeeds.

checks.topic: Read historical target under current ACL, never latest
checks.reason: _source active=False preserves actual principal/owner/workspace and root/fixed target current ACL using the immutable descriptor sidecar; it does not call latest/head resolution. Root unbound returns null. Unknown descriptor or foreign mapping is denied. Revocation/fence/archive block writes but need not erase readable existing acknowledgements.

checks.topic: Public Python API compatibility and original authority checks
checks.reason: Existing public signatures stay unchanged and retain one accounts._transaction. The extracted body retains _source, saved-receipt verification, exact saved target scope for new writes, per-(mapping,binding) earliest prefix, shared delivery, and post-write complete validation. The extra root_mapping_id argument is private, optional and only supplied by CID services; omitted public calls retain prior semantics.

The input has only descriptor_id; inherited extra=forbid/frozen disallows caller authority fields. The output contains only mode/state/descriptor_id/conversation_id/task_event_id/cursors/UTC time/opaque full receipt digest. Unit cursor progression is validated. No account/bot/peer/session/source_event/payload/reason is projected.
